description: This file defines a Commands class for interacting with a WebView component in a React Native app, providing methods to send commands, focus, blur, insert images, manage settings, and handle internal links within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Commands
classes.description: A class providing methods to send commands and interact with a WebView in a React Native environment, including focus, blur, content management, settings, and internal link handling.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes a JavaScript job in the WebView and retrieves the response.

methods.name: fn
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript function string with error handling for injection into WebView.

methods.name: doAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous job in the WebView context.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with arguments to the WebView for execution.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the WebView input for a specific tab, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the WebView input for a specific tab.

methods.name: clearContent
methods.description: Clears the content of the WebView for a specific tab.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID in the WebView.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status in the WebView for a specific tab.

methods.name: setPlaceholder
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting placeholder text (empty implementation).

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state in the WebView.

methods.name: setInsets
methods.description: Sets safe area insets in the WebView.

methods.name: updateSettings
methods.description: Updates the WebView settings with new partial settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets the WebView settings, optionally restoring previous settings.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets tags for a note across all related tabs.

methods.name: clearTags
methods.description: Clears tags in a specific tab.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts an attachment into the WebView for a specific tab.

methods.name: setAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates attachment upload progress.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into the WebView for a specific tab.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation in the WebView.

methods.name: keyboardShown
methods.description: Notifies the WebView about keyboard visibility.

methods.name: getTableOfContents
methods.description: Retrieves the table of contents from the WebView.

methods.name: focusPassInput
methods.description: Focuses the password input in the WebView.

methods.name: blurPassInput
methods.description: Blurs the password input in the WebView.

methods.name: createInternalLink
methods.description: Creates an internal link within the WebView.

methods.name: dismissCreateInternalLinkRequest
methods.description: Dismisses an internal link creation request.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewById
methods.description: Scrolls to an element by ID within the WebView.

methods.name: scrollToSearchResult
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific search result index.
